message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout right in the middle of a family movie night. Just as the screen went dark, my phone decided to join in and die on me! I realized how unprepared I was; I had no flashlight handy, and my power bank was sitting in my bag, not charged. Now, I keep a little stash of charged power banks and flashlights ready for those unexpected moments. It's amazing how a little prep can keep the good times rolling, even when the lights go out! What’s your favorite way to stay cozy during a power outage?
